title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta18

## Sound level device encoding fix

Field testing of beta17 exposed a clear device-side radix mismatch for
`volumeSetting`.

Observed HA write -> vendor readback pairs:

- 35 -> 53
- 10 -> 16
- 1 -> 1
- 0 -> 0
- 100 -> 16

The first two pairs match hexadecimal interpretation exactly:

- `"35"` interpreted as hex = decimal 53
- `"10"` interpreted as hex = decimal 16

This proves the mower/device command expects a hexadecimal string, while the
cloud setting remains a decimal string.

Beta18 therefore writes:

- mower/device: hexadecimal string, e.g. 35% -> `"23"`, 10% -> `"0A"`,
  100% -> `"64"`;
- cloud: decimal string, e.g. `"35"`, `"10"`, `"100"`.

The Sound level UI is also tightened to the intended user-facing range:

- minimum: 10%
- maximum: 100%
- step: 10%
- slider mode

Values below 10% are intentionally not exposed in the Home Assistant slider. This keeps a simple 10, 20, ... 100 scale while the relationship between very low `volumeSetting` values and the separate `soundSwitch` field remains outside the supported UI contract.

No Map Card update is required.
